public_rationale: This is a conditional forecast. Marcus says that if test-time scaling proves unreliable outside domains suited to data augmentation, it will get little commercial traction. The condition has not been clearly established. Some 2025 papers report brittleness under distribution shift; others report reasoning-trained models generalizing well. "Unreliable" and "adequate augmentation" have no agreed test, so it cannot be shown that the antecedent happened. Under the rules, a conditional forecast whose antecedent is unknown is not scored.
limitations: The antecedent is vague, so commercial traction evidence was not collected for scoring.
Literature on the antecedent was only briefly surveyed.
